accepted_risks: The first specification may overfit to CASE-001 and the RTS repository.
Achievement extraction may create false positives or inflated interpretations.
Human versus AI contribution may remain ambiguous in some records.
No customer demand, price acceptance, or market response has been validated.
P1 may reveal a need to revise the P3 source boundary before implementation.
first_audience: AI-assisted solo developers and solo founders whose GitHub history contains useful work that is difficult to explain externally.
first_paid_product: Evidence-Backed Achievement Discovery Report: a bounded GitHub/PR evidence audit producing approved achievement claims, contribution mapping, and reusable portfolio or sales copy.
frozen_branches: P2 full public evidence shell, except one later human-approved output draft
P4 sales automation and large-scale outreach
P5 Support Fit and social-reconnection automation
P6 Talent DB, matching platform, enterprise API, and OEM
automatic human ranking or eligibility decisions

judgment_criteria.assessment: P1 and P3 directly create the evidence-to-value core required by the final reconnection model.
A fixed RTS PR set can produce a bounded ten-candidate test without building publishing, matching, or support systems.
The same approved output can become a manual achievement-discovery or GitHub evidence-audit deliverable.
One repository, one deterministic pipeline, WIP=1, and human review fit the current operating constraints.
The canonical records and evidence model can feed P2, P4, P5, and P6 without committing to those branches now.

maximum_scope: P3 minimum vertical slice using one fixed RTS repository/PR set; no publication, outreach, provider expansion, contracts, ranking, support automation, or platform build.
next_review_point: After P1 artifacts are complete and before any P3 code or repository mutation.
project_name: Proof Engine (working title) within the broader Reconnect concept; public brand NOT_APPROVED.
public_disclosure_boundary: Only human-approved PUBLIC evidence from already public repository history may enter a public draft. CASE-001 health, family, employment, legal, financial, location, credentials, private repositories, and third-party personal details remain excluded.
reason: P1→P3 maximizes evidence-producing progress and future reuse while keeping cost, authority, privacy, and scope bounded.
recorded_from: Explicit human instruction in the governing conversation
